nodes.label: Pour cereal from the cereal box into the bowl
Pour
details: description: Continuous modulation of tilt angle and grip/load force while substance leaves container

nodes.label: Lift
details: description: Vertical transport of source container away from initial support

nodes.label: Grasp
details: description: Parallel increase of grip and load force after contact until liftoff

nodes.label: StopFlow
details: description: Counter-rotation to bring substance back below lip

nodes.label: Tilt
details: description: Rotation of source container until substance reaches lip and flow begins

nodes.label: Transport
details: description: Translation of coupled effector-container unit toward target receptacle

nodes.label: Reach
details: description: Transport of grasping effector toward source container

nodes.label: Release
details: description: Decrease of grip and load force to zero after touchdown

nodes.label: Lower
details: description: Lowering of source container toward initial support

nodes.label: Upright
details: description: Restoration of source container to stable orientation after flow stops

nodes.label: Align
details: description: Positioning of pouring lip over target receptacle opening

nodes.label: Withdraw
details: description: Breaking of effector-object contact and withdrawal

nodes.label: BoxManipulation
details: description: Reach and grasp the cereal box

nodes.label: BoxPoseControl
details: description: Lift and orient the cereal box

nodes.label: GripLoadAdaptation

nodes.label: TiltInducedRelease
